analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 61,995) vs SMA5 (KRW 58,211) / SMA20 (KRW 67,893) / SMA50 (KRW 90,866): Short-term trend above, medium-term trend below diagnosis.
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 113,961) / SMA200 (KRW 113,042): Strong weakness in long-term trend.
· 52-week position (11.3%): Current price level located near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.3→38.9): Neutral zone sustained, failure to escape oversold or cool from overbought diagnosis.
· MACD histogram trajectory (916.1712→-174.1984): Weakness continues, no trend reversal signal generated.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 67,893): Sideways movement near the middle band, band width 40.65% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 61,145): Support zone based on Pivot S1 (KRW 47,435) and 5-day/20-day lows (KRW 51,065).
· Swing Resistance (KRW 80,380): Resistance zone based on Pivot R1 (KRW 80,185) and 5-day/20-day highs (KRW 68,000 / KRW 83,815).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): 5-day high KRW 68,000, 20-day high KRW 83,815. 5-day low KRW 51,065, 20-day low KRW 51,065. No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.78x): Contracted compared to the 5-day average, indicating lower confidence in the movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Lack of clear direction, increased uncertainty due to contracted volume. Entry consideration after further indicator confirmation.
